name: ky-company-formation
description: Forming a company in the Cayman Islands in 2026, step by step. Covers the entity types (exempted company, ordinary company, limited duration company, LLC, exempted limited partnership), registration with the General Registry and its 2026 exempted company registration fees by share capital (CI$700 to CI$42,000 of capital, then CI$1,000, CI$1,984 and CI$2,568), the annual fees (CI$925 to CI$2,793 in 2026, rising on 1 January 2027), beneficial ownership at 25% or more, CRS and FATCA dates, the tax undertaking, economic substance notification, and what follows. No tax registration is needed because there is no income tax or VAT. Trigger on Cayman company formation, exempted company Cayman, register a company in Cayman, General Registry fees. Built from the General Registry fee table and Cayman legislation; not reviewed by an accountant.
